c.tagline: Gateway to Tirumala — hill shrine of Lord Venkateswara and one of Earth's most-visited temples.

taxi.fareNote: App cabs (Uber/Ola) use meters; shared and street autos are usually negotiated, so agree the fare before setting off.

emergency.note: 112 is India's single all-services emergency number; 100 also reaches police and 108 an ambulance.

avoid.reason: Beware touts selling fake or 'special' darshan tickets and pickpockets in the dense temple queues at Tirumala.

hood_desc: The sacred hill town 22 km above Tirupati, home to the Sri Venkateswara (Balaji) Temple and the TTD pilgrim lodges; the reason most visitors come, though stays are basic and temple-focused.
The bustling core around Tirupati Main Railway Station, packed with hotels, vegetarian restaurants and shops; the most convenient base for pilgrims arriving by train.
The transport hub opposite the central APSRTC bus terminal, lined with mid-range and budget hotels; handy for onward buses to Tirumala and other cities.
The airport-and-highway corridor east of town where most of Tirupati's upscale business hotels and resorts sit; quieter, with easy airport access.
The foot of the Seshachalam hills where the 3,550-step footpath to Tirumala begins, near the giant Venkateswara statue; atmospheric for pilgrims starting the climb.

water.note: Drink bottled or filtered water only.

transit.hours: City and pilgrim buses run from around 4:00 AM (for early darshan) until late evening; APSRTC ghat buses climb to Tirumala around the clock.
transit.note: Tirupati has no metro or local rail; APSRTC buses, shared autos and taxis serve the city, while frequent APSRTC ghat-road buses shuttle pilgrims up to the Tirumala hill temple.
transit.pay: Bus fares are paid in cash to the conductor (or via the APSRTC app); autos are negotiated or metered.

bus: Intercity coaches to Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad
train: Tirupati Main Railway Station — trains to Chennai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and across India

transit.m: APSRTC airport bus to Tirupati city (~40 min)
Pre-paid taxi to city center (25-30 min)

tip.r: Tipping is not obligatory; rounding up or 5-10% for good service at restaurants is appreciated.
